name: Joint List
description: Alliance of Arab parties (Hadash, Ta'al, Balad); ran 2015–2021 and revived for 2026.

name: Ra'am
description: United Arab List; Islamist-rooted party focused on Arab citizens' interests.

name: Hadash–Ta'al
description: Joint run of Hadash (Ayman Odeh) and Ta'al (Ahmad Tibi) after the Joint List split in 2022.

name: Balad
description: Arab nationalist party advocating a 'state of all its citizens'.

name: Meretz
description: Left-wing, secular, social-democratic party. Merged into The Democrats in 2024.

name: Labor
description: Historic center-left party. Merged into The Democrats in 2024.

name: The Democrats
description: Social-democratic, liberal-Zionist merger of Labor and Meretz, led by Yair Golan.

name: Yesh Atid
description: Centrist, secular-liberal party led by Yair Lapid. Runs inside Together in 2026.

name: National Unity
description: Centrist alliance of Benny Gantz's Blue and White and Gideon Sa'ar's New Hope, joined by Gadi Eisenkot; later broke apart.

name: Yashar!
description: Centrist, security-focused party founded by former IDF chief Gadi Eisenkot.

name: Together (Beyachad)
description: Joint list of Naftali Bennett (Bennett 2026) and Yair Lapid (Yesh Atid).

name: Yisrael Beiteinu
description: Secular nationalist party with a base among immigrants from the former Soviet Union.

name: Reservists–Economy
description: Joint list of Yoaz Hendel's Reservists and Yaron Zelekha's New Economic Party.

name: Jewish Home
description: Religious-Zionist party; in 2022 led by Ayelet Shaked. Did not run in 2026.

name: United Torah Judaism
description: Ashkenazi Haredi alliance of Agudat Yisrael and Degel HaTorah.

name: Shas
description: Mizrahi Haredi party led by Aryeh Deri.

name: Likud
description: Dominant right-wing party led by Benjamin Netanyahu.

name: Amcha Yisrael
description: Right-wing, security-focused party founded by Brig. Gen. (res.) Ofer Winter.

name: Religious Zionist Party
description: Far-right religious-Zionist party led by Bezalel Smotrich (formerly Tkuma).

name: Otzma Yehudit
description: Far-right, Kahanist party led by Itamar Ben-Gvir.
